description: Canonical reusable local audio event mapping for remix operators. Operators should copy selected files into target game outputs and reference local copied paths only.
runtime_rules: Use audio URLs from assets/audio_library/audios.json for CDN-backed runtime audio.
Do not invent remote audio URLs outside the trusted audio index.
Missing optional audio must degrade safely without crashing.
Initialize playback from user gesture paths when browser autoplay policy requires it.
Only trusted CDN audio URLs listed in assets/audio_library/audios.json are allowed.
Preserve existing gameplay mechanics when adding or remapping audio.
